 Through: Ms. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG  Mr. Ravinder Gupta, AAG Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY DHAR, JUDGE  ORDER 15.03.2024 1.
On 16.11.2022, learned counsel for the petitioners had submitted that the petitioners are entitled to compensation to the tune of Rs. 15,00,000/-.

In the latest statement of facts filed by the Deputy Commissioner, Kulgam, it has been submitted that there is no progress in the land acquisition and no amount has been disbursed to the land owners whose land has come under alignment of the road.
It has been submitted that the Private Negotiation Committee meeting was scheduled to be held on 07.08.2023 but the land owners did not attend the said meeting.
It has been further submitted that the land in question has been donated by the land owners way back in the year 2010.

2. The stand of the Deputy Commissioner that the land in question has been donated by the land owners is not borne out from the record inasmuch as no such document has been placed on record along with the statement of facts.

The petitioners had approached this Court by way of the writ petition seeking compensation in respect of the land utilized by the respondents and the objections were filed by the respondents in which no such stand was taken by them, so at this stage it is not open to the respondents to contend that the petitioners have donated the land in question.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners do not intend to enter into further negotiations with the respondents.

In view of this position, the only option with the respondents would be either to accept the offer made by the learned counsel for the petitioners on 16.11.2022 or to initiate and conclude the process of acquisition of the land of the petitioners in accordance with the Act of 2013, which is the purport of the order of the Writ Court passed on 25.08.2015.
The respondents are directed to seek instructions in this regard and report the same by next date of hearing.

4. List on 08.05.2024.
5. Copy of this order be furnished to Mr. Ravinder Gupta, AAG for information.
(SANJAY DHAR) JUDGE Jammu 15.03.2024
